name: FIGURE'S LIBRARY 📚
desc:
A game where you can practice the DOORS library without going through 50 rooms.

After taking a random elevator, you find yourself locked inside a library with raw meat!
The lock requires a code to open. Find books scattered throughout the library and decipher the code with bpaper.

This game uses assets & ideas from DOORS by LSPLASH. All credit goes to the LSPLASH team.
This game is fan-made and not affiliated with LSPLASH.

🥩📚 Liked the game? Join the Figure's Library group! https://www.roblox.com/communities/33741245
